subject: Deployment and migration preference follow-up — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@novacare.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment and migration preference follow-up — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private

Alex —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap from our side and the two asks we discussed:

Summary (short):
- Demo covered Redwood hosted API, Dedicated reserved capacity, and Private VPC/on-prem options.
- Showed latency/throughput profile for the curation pipeline and a short run of our batching behavior.

Open questions we agreed to confirm:
1) Preferred deployment mode: Hosted (fastest on-ramp), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput), or Private VPC/on-prem (data control/compliance).
2) Current migration source: are you coming from OpenAI API, another LLM API, a self-hosted Triton/TorchServe cluster, or legacy on-prem GPU pools? Any constraints (e.g., PHI, Gov data, private keys) matter for mode selection.

Quick ask / next steps:
- Can you confirm preferred deployment mode and whether PHI/regulatory constraints require VPC/on-prem?
- Please share a brief note on your current traffic profile (avg qps, peak burst qps, 95p latency target) — Ben can run a point estimate for Dedicated sizing.

I attached the demo deck for reference (slides called out the model variants and the Dedicated sizing heuristic).

Proposed next call: Ben (solutions) + Vanessa (AM) + me to do a 30-min technical check on Friday morning (PST). If that works, share best time slots.

Thanks,

—Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood-inference.com
Attachment: 20280614-redwood-demo-deck.pdf (slides PDF, 8 pages)
From: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@novacare.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment and migration preference follow-up — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private

Priyom —

Thanks for the clear recap and the deck — useful. A few clarifications from my side:

1) Migration source and constraints
- Primary traffic today goes to OpenAI (text-gen/chat) via their API — that’s about 80% of volume.
- We are also running a small set of models on an internal Triton cluster (NVIDIA A100s) for sensitive customer redaction workloads. Those jobs still live on-prem because they touch PHI.
- Procurement wants to avoid moving PHI into any public multi-tenant endpoint; we would need VPC or on-prem for those flows. Non-PHI inference could be a candidate for Hosted or Dedicated.

2) Preferred deployment mode
- Leaning toward Dedicated for daytime production (predictable throughput and cost) + a Private/VPC option for the PHI workloads. We want to understand if we can route by policy (send PHI traffic to Private, non-PHI to Dedicated/Hosted).

3) Traffic/profile rough numbers (sanitized):
- Average token throughput today: ~120k tokens/min (inference + assistant-style chat).
- Peak bursts: up to ~950 requests/min with spiky patterns (five minute bursts).
- Latency target: 95th percentile under 300ms for short completions; longer jobs okay up to 1s.

4) Timeline
- Procurement evaluation window: 6–8 weeks. We want a pilot that validates throughput and a small security review for VPC connectivity.

If Ben can estimate Dedicated sizing and confirm routing/fallback policies between Dedicated and Private, that would be great. Happy to join the call Friday.

—Alex
Alex Thompson
Director of Engineering, NovaCare AI
alex.thompson@novacare.ai
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@novacare.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment and migration preference follow-up — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private

Alex —

Appreciate the details — very helpful. Looping Ben and Vanessa to pick up the sizing and connectivity items.

Ben: Can you do a quick Dedicated sizing estimate from Alex’s numbers and confirm whether our routing policies can direct PHI-tagged requests to a Private/VPC pool while keeping non-PHI traffic on Dedicated? Also: do we need sample traces or token-distribution snapshots to refine the estimate?

Vanessa: Procurement timeline note — Alex mentioned 6–8 weeks. Would you like me to share our standard pilot MSA + SOC2 + architecture diagram now so they can start legal/security review in parallel? I attached a short migration checklist that maps carrier scenarios (OpenAI -> Hosted, OpenAI -> Dedicated, Triton/on-prem -> Private) to the minimum artifacts we need.

Proposed next steps and owners:
- Ben: Dedicated sizing + routing confirmation (deliverable: sizing note) — due Tue EOD next week.
- Vanessa: Send pilot MSA + SOC2 links to Alex (deliverable: procurement package) — today.
- Alex: Share an S3 link (or redact logs) with a 30-min sample of traces if possible (Ben will use for a perf estimate).

If Friday still works, proposed window: 8:30–9:30am PST. Let me know which slots are best.

Thanks,

—Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood-inference.com
Attachment: migration-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, headers: scenario, artifact_needed, contact)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment and migration preference follow-up — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private

Alex / Priyom —

Thanks — I can take the sizing. Based on Alex’s sanitized numbers a ballpark Dedicated configuration would be: 4x A100-equivalent GPUs with continuous batching to meet 95p <300ms on short completions (we’ll refine with traces).

Routing: yes — we support request-routing by tag/policy. Two practical approaches:
- Per-tenant routing: send NovaCare non-PHI tenant traffic to Dedicated pool; send PHI-tagged tenant/route to your Private/VPC deployment.
- Header-based routing: Redwood proxy can route based on a request header (e.g., X-NovaCare-Data-Class).

What I need from you (Alex):
- A 30-min sample (redacted) of logs or token traces (S3 link fine).
- A representative prompt set for short completions (so I can run a perf estimate).

Friday call — I’m available 8:30–9:00am PST or 10:00–10:30am PST. If 8:30 works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda: confirm routing approach, sizing assumptions, next steps for pilot (connectivity & security artifacts).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
